hints.title: Parity Inversion on Removal
hints.text: Removing an element at index i causes all subsequent elements to shift parity between even and odd.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Parity Sums
hints.text: Compute total sums of even and odd indices across the entire array before iterating.

hints.title: New Parity Equation
hints.text: For removed index i, new even sum is prefix even plus remaining total odd, and new odd sum is prefix odd plus remaining total even.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing sums after every index removal takes quadratic O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running prefix totals allow checking each index in O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes suffix parity shifts and maintains running prefix/suffix totals.
